result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue: a time badge on one of the restaurant cards is vertically misaligned compared to its neighbors.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the '20-30 min' time badge on the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is positioned significantly lower than the badges on the adjacent cards, sitting almost flush with the bottom edge of the image.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom positioning or padding of the time badge on this card to be consistent with the inset spacing used on the other cards in the carousel.
